paragraphs.text: We are much distressed, for we are gifted with the nature not of rocks but of men, but the recollection of the Lord's Epiphany has been to me a very potent medicine; so at once I write, according to the custom of the feast, and salute your magnificence with a prayer that you may live in prosperity and repute.

source.source_note: Source. Translated by Blomfield Jackson. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vol. 3. Edited by Philip Schaff and Henry Wace. latex.p0003: 我们深感痛苦，因为我们本非岩石，而是具有人的本性；然而，对主显节的回忆对我而言是一剂极为有效的良药；因此我立刻遵照节日的惯例写信，并以祈祷问候您的尊贵，愿您生活昌盛、享有美誉。
